core.method: Coordinated aggregation of actual independent main-picture inspection, independent state-picture reports and exact bounded-repair checks. This aggregate is not a claim that the coordinator personally reopened every image.

advanced.method: The previous complete visual review actually viewed all 49 main screens and all 65 state boards through 20 contact sheets, with 13 critical originals additionally viewed full-size. This round independently recomputed SHA256 for all 49 main PNGs (byte-identical to that review) and all 65 baseline/current state PNG pairs, and independently used Pillow ImageChops.difference on RGB pixels plus getbbox for every state pair. Every state delta was exactly [93,923,207,935], entirely below all state cards (bottom y=897); card/content pixels are identical to the previously inspected version. Only the current aim-ranged--states-1.png, bionic-surgery--states-1.png and vehicle-parts--states-1.png were actually re-opened at original size in this round, confirming the lower-layer footnote ghost is removed. Acceptance therefore combines the earlier complete actual content review with this independent bounded-difference recheck; it does not claim that all current state PNGs or new contact sheets were visually re-viewed.

limitations: Unity import, Sprite rendering, Prefab assembly, game logic and runtime integration are outside this phase.
Full-screen PNGs are compositions using native-size painted resources and separate text; not new native image-model renders for every screen.
Model and quality are host-managed and unconfirmed where no return metadata was disclosed.
